text.en: Pet owners frequently express deep gratitude to veterinarians like Dr. Fusco and Dr. Perez for attentive emergency triage and life-saving surgical procedures. Clients emphasize that medical staff provided comfort during frightening trauma visits. However, several reviewers report negative interactions with reception personnel and emergency billing staff, noting unhelpful guidance and perceived insensitivity.

Multiple reviewers praise the emergency center for saving dogs in critical distress, successfully treating severe animal attacks, and completing complex orthopedic procedures like CCL repairs. Pets recovered with minimal surgical complications under intensive monitoring. Conversely, two families experienced tragic losses, reporting that treatments failed to stabilize severely ill companions despite high medical spending.

title.en: Rapid critical triage with occasional delays

text.en: When companion animals arrive with respiratory failure or acute trauma, clients report that clinicians admit them immediately within seconds. At the same time, reviewers with non-critical walk-ins or scheduled consultations describe waiting over an hour in exam rooms without diagnostic progress, leading to elevated stress for waiting pets.

q.en: Does the hospital take walk-in emergency cases around the clock?

a.en: Yes, the emergency facility operates 24 hours daily and admits acute trauma and urgent walk-in cases immediately without prior notice.

q.en: How quickly are critical patients seen upon arrival?

a.en: Pets suffering severe acute distress are triaged within seconds, though owners of stable cases note occasional waiting room delays during busy hours.

q.en: Are advanced emergency surgeries performed on-site?

a.en: Yes, on-site surgeons perform emergency procedures, orthopedic repairs, and intensive surgical monitoring for hospitalized animals.
